title: God Is With You | A Prayer For When You Feel Lonely And Nobody Calls
description:
God is with you. A word and a prayer for when you feel lonely and nobody calls.

David felt desolate. Paul stood trial with no one beside him. Scripture on the God who stays, sets the solitary in families, and has your name on his hands. Ends with a prayer.

"And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed." Deuteronomy 31:8 (KJV)

Scriptures in this video (KJV): Psalm 25:16, 2 Timothy 4:16-17, Psalm 139:7-10, Deuteronomy 31:8, Psalm 27:10, Isaiah 49:15-16, Psalm 68:6, Ecclesiastes 4:9-10, Proverbs 18:24, Matthew 28:20.

Type amen in the comments, and send this to a friend who needs it. Subscribe to Blessed Prayers for more.
